description: This file defines the ResidentProvider class which manages residents data including loading, querying, adding, updating, and deleting residents. It interacts with ResidentStorage for persistence and uses UUIDs for unique identification.

classes.name: ResidentProvider
classes.description: A provider class that manages a list of Resident objects, providing methods to initialize, query, add, update, and delete residents, while persisting data through ResidentStorage.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Loads the list of residents from persistent storage asynchronously and marks the provider as loaded.

methods.name: isLoaded
methods.description: Getter that indicates whether the residents data has been loaded.

methods.name: getResidents
methods.description: Returns a list of residents filtered by an optional query string.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Sets the current search query string used for filtering residents.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a resident by their unique ID, returns null if not found.

methods.name: addResident
methods.description: Creates a new resident with provided details, assigns a UUID, adds to the list, persists the data, and returns the new resident ID.

methods.name: updateResident
methods.description: Updates an existing resident's data and persists changes.

methods.name: deleteResident
methods.description: Removes a resident by ID from the list and updates persistent storage.
